title: The Smothered Mate
setup: Black's king is walled in on h8 by its own rook and pawns, one square short of a famous cage.
hint: The king is nearly buried by its own pieces. Which square is still free, and can you make it fill it?
explanation:
## The Idea

This is the **smothered mate**. {{Qg8+}} offers the queen on a square the knight on **h6** defends, so the king cannot take and {{Rxg8}} is forced. That plugs the last free square, and {{Nf7#}} lands where no knight check can ever be blocked.
